name: God's Eye View
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24.14.0; nvm use 24.14.0; NODE_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24.14.0)")"; ln -sf "$NODE_BIN_DIR/node" /usr/local/cargo/bin/node; ln -sf "$NODE_BIN_DIR/npm" /usr/local/cargo/bin/npm; ln -sf "$NODE_BIN_DIR/npx" /usr/local/cargo/bin/npx; npm install
